items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] E. Flat was his name? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, the bass violin. The other one called him E. Flat.

ctx.x: I think it's me and Lee Collin did. We went over there to Mandeville. We played over there at the hotel. Me and Lee had the van in. We played for a hotel over there. Every Saturday night, you know, during the summer session. We played for a couple of days. We played for a couple of days. We played for a couple of days. We played bass violin. The Fritz brothers.
Yeah, the bass violin. The other one called him E. Flat. The Fritz brothers, good kind of guy. We're still over there. Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson, Lake Brownshed.
